We Offer The Best Veterinary Services
In Pet Zone we believe in specialism so we have in our team a specialized vet in every veterinary speciality We have an orthopedic surgeon, cardiologist, dermatology department for diagnosis and treatment, specialized dentist, department for Gynecology and artificial insemination, ophthalmologist and oncology department for diagnosis and surgery.
Welcome to Our Veterinary Clinics
Pet Zone Branches
In Pet Zone, we try to be near you as possible as we can so we have Branches in New Cairo, Heliopolis and Dokki to cover all zones in Cairo and Giza.
We also have an ambulance to reach you wherever you are to do in-home regular check-up, vaccinations and grooming and for transportation to the nearest branch for further diagnostic procedures.
Fully equipped center
In every pet zone branch we have a fully equipped surgery room, x-ray and ultrasound , vet lab for all blood work , boarding room and grooming area
Specialized doctors
We have in our team well trained Vet surgeon specialized in orthopedic surgery and other for cardiology who can do ECG , Echo and other cardiac examinations.
We have also a specialized Dentist for all dental care needed for your pet
Filling system
Every client enters pet zone will fill a form with his information and a full details about his pet.
This form will take a number and will enter in our system.
Once you have a file and become a member of pet zone family you will be notified with a phone call or sms with his vaccination ,deworming and de flea program.
every visit to the clinic will be recorded so all your pet medical history will be saved
